variants.title: Crystallite size of ZnO nanoparticles by XRD (Scherrer)
variants.unknown: the crystallite size of a ZnO nanopowder
variants.note: Wurtzite ZnO, hexagonal; its strongest line is (101) near 36.3 degrees. The 25 nm size is a value of this batch (set by the synthesis, which is not simulated), not a property of ZnO.

source.title: Lattice parameters, ICDD powder diffraction file / Wyckoff, Crystal Structures; Cu K-alpha1 1.5406 A

variants.title: Crystallite size of TiO2 (anatase) nanoparticles by XRD (Scherrer)
variants.unknown: the crystallite size of an anatase TiO2 nanopowder
variants.note: Anatase, body-centred tetragonal; its strongest line is (101) near 25.3 degrees. The 12 nm size is a value of this batch, not a property of TiO2.

source.title: Lattice parameters, ICDD powder diffraction file / Wyckoff, Crystal Structures; Cu K-alpha1 1.5406 A

variants.title: Crystallite size of Fe2O3 (hematite) nanoparticles by XRD (Scherrer)
variants.unknown: the crystallite size of a hematite nanopowder
variants.note: Hematite, rhombohedral (indexed on hexagonal axes); its strongest line is (104) near 33.2 degrees. The 30 nm size is a value of this batch, not a property of Fe2O3.

source.title: Lattice parameters, ICDD powder diffraction file / Wyckoff, Crystal Structures; Cu K-alpha1 1.5406 A
